metadata.description:
Olson Family: Turning vacations into legendary adventures since 2004! 

From the cobblestone streets of Old Montréal to the rolling hills of Stowe, the Olson clan embarked on an epic 7-day journey! We danced with lights at Notre-Dame's Aura Experience, conquered the rapids on jet boats, mastered the art of bagel-making, and gasped in wonder at Cirque du Soleil.

Border-hopping adventurers explored underground cities, soared on zip lines, and cheered at fireworks over the Old Port. In Vermont, we sampled Ben & Jerry's finest, hiked mountain trails, and raised steins at Von Trapp's Bierhall. From sunrise farmer's markets to sunset dinners, 22 years of family traditions created memories to last a lifetime.

July 30 - August 6, 2025 | Montréal, Quebec & Stowe, Vermont
metadata.name: Olson Family Vacation 2025
